newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Jan 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Jan 28.

text.p: Four leading chip makers -- Toshiba Corp, Hitachi Ltd, Fujitsu Ltd and Mitsubishi Electric Corp -- are expected to cut their total capital investment by about 10 percent to about 750 billion yen in the year starting on April 1 as they expect lower earnings due to a sharp decline in prices of 16-megabit dynamic random-access memory chips (DRAMs). NEC Corp will be the only company to keep about same level as in fiscal 1996/97. The makers are not planning to cut investment in 64-megabit DRAMs or other advanced chips to maintain competitiveness.
